newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo under selling pressure, wary of central bank.
newsitem.headline: Escudo under selling pressure, wary of central bank.

text.p: The escudo was under slight selling pressure in early trade, but dealers said the market was wary of intervention by the Bank of Portugal and the cross was unlikely to slip too far.
The currency was trading at 101.02/05 to the mark against its 101.03/08 close on Thursday. Traders did not see it moving any great distance from that level.
The closure of the Spanish market today for a holiday meant volume was likely to be thin, they added.
